AKR796.XML.FILE_SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(DEPT_NO,1,2) AS DEPT_NO,DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM DOC_MAIN A,TRAN_D B WHERE A.SOURCE_ORGNO=B.SOURCE_ORGNO AND A.DOC_NO=B.DOC_NO AND B.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND B.TX_CODE='20' AND B.ENTRY_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND DEPT_NO ＜＞ '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(DEPT_NO,1,2), DEPT_NAME
AKR796.XML.UNINP_SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(D.DEPT_NO,1,2) AS DEPT_NO,D.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM DOC_MAIN D WHERE D.DOC_STATE IN ('20','25') AND D.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND (D.INPFILE_DATE='' OR D.INPFILE_DATE IS NULL) AND D.DEPT_NO ＜＞ '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(D.DEPT_NO,1,2), D.DEPT_NAME
AKR796.XML.INP_SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(DEPT_NO,1,2) AS DEPT_NO, DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM DOC_MAIN D WHERE D.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND D.INPFILE_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND D.KEEP_YEAR ＜＞ '99' AND (D.FILE_YEAR ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_YEAR IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_CLS ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_CLS IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_CASE ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_CASE IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_VOL ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_VOL IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_SEQ ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_SEQ IS NOT NULL) AND DEPT_NO ＜＞'' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(DEPT_NO,1,2) , DEPT_NAME
AKR796.XML.BOR_SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(BM.DEPT_NO,1,2) AS DEPT_NO , BM.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(BT.DOC_NO) AS NUM FROM BORROW_MAIN BM,BORROW_TRAN BT WHERE BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND BM.BOR_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND BT.EXEC_TYPE IN ('1','2','3') AND BM.STATUS＞='3' AND BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=BT.SOURCE_ORGNO AND BM.BOR_NO=BT.BOR_NO AND BM.DEPT_NO ＜＞ '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(BM.DEPT_NO,1,2), BM.DEPT_NAME
AKR796.XML.RET_SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(BM.DEPT_NO,1,2) AS DEPT_NO , BM.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(BT.DOC_NO) AS NUM FROM BORROW_MAIN BM,BORROW_TRAN BT WHERE BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND BM.BOR_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND BT.EXEC_TYPE IN ('6’,’7') AND BM.STATUS＞='3' AND BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=BT.SOURCE_ORGNO AND BM.BOR_NO=BT.BOR_NO AND BM.DEPT_NO ＜＞ '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(BM.DEPT_NO,1,2), BM.DEPT_NAME
